expected_level_description: You can: - code complex episodes across specialties - audit coding quality and train coders
You can: - find and use the right codes for a data item or form - use terminology browsers and reference sets
You can: - process requests for access to records - apply retention schedules and record-keeping standards
You can: - run data quality checks and correct errors - explain data quality reports to colleagues
You can: - apply data protection principles to your work - contribute to data protection impact assessments - handle information requests and records correctly

You can: - explain the clinical and care workflows your work supports - use common health care terms correctly with clinical and care colleagues - recognise when a change could affect patient care and raise it

You can: - listen to the needs of design and business stakeholders and interpret information - take part in discussions within a multidisciplinary team - be an advocate for the team externally, and can manage differing perspectives - shape and share communications relevant to the audience
You can: - explain the organisation's people policies that affect you - support new colleagues and share knowledge
